pcs.pc_description: Evaluate the quality of the water source intended for purification
select the most suitable water purifier system for specific needs
Select the appropriate purification technology and system capacity

Consider factors such as the type of contaminants to be removed, the desired level of purification, water consumption rate, and available space for installation. Properly sizing the system ensures optimal performance and efficiency.
Evaluate the available options and select the most suitable water purifier for your needs..
Determine if any permits or approvals are required for installing a water purifier system in your area
Follow regulations or codes that need to be followed
Contact the appropriate local authorities or agencies to understand the legal requirements and ensure compliance if any
Identify the best location for installing the water purifier system.

Explain factors such as proximity to the water source, access to plumbing connections, availability of electrical outlets (if required), drainage options, and convenient access for maintenance and filter replacements
Ensure that there is adequate space around the installation location for easy access during installation and future maintenance activities
Allow for sufficient clearance to connect plumbing lines, electrical connections, and access the system for servicing and heat dissipation.
Ensure that these utilities are functioning properly and meet the requirements of the water purifier system being installed.

Understand the installation instructions and guidelines provided by the manufacturer of the water purifier system. These instructions may include specific requirements, recommendations, or precautions that need to be followed during installation

Ensure that all required components and materials for installation, such as plumbing fittings, connectors, pipes, electrical wiring, and mounting hardware, are procured and readily available before starting the installation process.
Prepare the installation site by ensuring it is clean, clear of any obstructions, and suitable for accommodating the water purifier system.
Remove debris, organize the area, and provide sufficient space for the system and associated components
Locate and shut off the main water supply
Connect the water purifier system to the existing plumbing lines.
Mount the water purifier unit securely
Ensure proper wiring is in place.
Connect power cables, and install switches or outlets as per the manufacturer's guidelines.
Install any pre-filters or post-filters that are part of the water purifier system.
Follow the manufacturer's instructions for their installation.
Set up the necessary drainage system for the water purifier unit, especially if it utilizes technologies such as reverse osmosis (RO).
Conduct testing the system to ensure its proper functionality.
Perform calibration of any necessary settings, such as flow rate or pressure regulators, is performed at this stage.
Provide the user with instructions on operating and maintaining the water purifier system.
Explain how to use the control panel (if applicable), replace filters, perform routine maintenance, and troubleshoot common issues.
Demonstrate proper usage to ensure the user's understanding.
After the installation is finalized, clean up the installation area, removing any debris, packaging materials, or tools used during the process.
Restore any disrupted areas, such as patching holes or restoring wall surfaces, if necessary
Educate the client on how to operate the system.

modules.module_title: Routine Maintenance of Water purifier system and fault finding

pcs.pc_description: Monitor the system's pressure to ensure it is within the recommended range.
check the electrical connections, cables, and plugs for any signs of wear, damage, or loose connections.
Identify and check codes or alarms, and address and resolve any identified issues accordingly
Maintain proper documentation of the maintenance activities
Obtain feedback from the users regarding the water quality, system reliability, and overall performance should be considered to gauge the effectiveness of the maintenance process.
Utilize diagnostic tools, if available, to assess the system's performance and identify specific faults or malfunctions.
Follow appropriate steps to repair or replace the faulty component or system part.
Follow the manufacturer's guidelines or consult a professional if necessary.
Carry out thorough cleaning of water purifier to remove any dirt, sediment, or debris that may accumulate over time.
Evaluate water quality by testing the water for parameters such as pH, total dissolved solids (TDS), microbial contamination, and chemical impurities.
Ensure that the flow rate of the purified water should be within the acceptable range specified by the manufacturer.
Check the water purifier for any leaks or drips during maintenance.
identify faults and repair promptly to prevent water wastage and system damage.
conduct tests to ensure that the system is functioning properly and meets the required performance criteria mentioned earlier.
conduct functional tests on the system to identify any abnormal behavior or malfunctions.
